id.description: Reverse-dns identity as publisher.name, e.g. acme.markdown-lint. Stable across versions and used as the install directory name. Must match the id in the signed release manifest.

author.description: Who publishes it, shown on the card.

description.description: One-line summary shown on the card.

category.description: Free-form grouping, e.g. lint, format, ai.

version.description: Semver of the release to install. Must equal the GitHub release tag.

min_app_version.description: Lowest Jensen version the plugin supports, for display. The signed manifest is authoritative and is re-checked at install.

repo.description: GitHub owner/name that hosts the plugin's releases. Jensen fetches the release assets from github.com/<repo>/releases/download/<version>/.

sha256.description: Checksum of the release manifest.json. Because that manifest pins each artifact's checksum, this one hash vouches for the whole download; it is verified at install.
